name: bandit.phase4_structural_signal_matrix_live_mcw
description: Phase-4 live sound-positive proof on one production-owned schema-10 structural sortie. The derived handoff fixture preserves the same signal footing and adds only DEBUG_CLAIRVOYANCE. An idle five-member camp autonomously dispatches its exact pair toward source-proved terrain-opportunity road target (137,49,0), approaches through (139,51,0), and watches from (138,52,0). Before approach, the passive avatar is explicitly relocated three OMT west to (136,49,0): the target remains loaded for real setup while approach/watch remain abstract. The pair first reaches the selected watch at minute 10080 without an observation; only then does scenario setup place one real SPAWN_ACTIVE explosive 36 map squares east on the unchanged target, and the next ordinary cadence proves one target-to-watch sound fact. After that sound fact, the avatar is explicitly relocated three OMT east to reload the physical return route. Production must retain the sound fact and create exactly one returned_report sound lead only after physical return.
artifact_patterns: structural outing reached selected watch without resolving remote lead=overmap_special:bandit_camp@140,51,0:terrain_opportunity:137,49,0:road

evidence_contract.claim: one autonomous schema-10 abstract scout pair reaches its selected watch without an observation, then reads one credible post-arrival semantic explosion from the committed target footprint, retains that typed sound fact without creating camp knowledge early, and creates exactly one bounded returned_report sound lead only after physical return
evidence_contract.setup_boundary: passive debug-cloaked player relocation, the source-proved road lead, and one real SPAWN_ACTIVE explosive staged only after watch arrival are fixture/scenario footing; the derived observer child adds only DEBUG_CLAIRVOYANCE and its transform report must name that mutation; no typed observation, signal lead, target footprint, watch selection, route position, camp report, or return is injected
evidence_contract.load_only_verdict: load/setup proof only / inconclusive for the structural signal matrix
evidence_contract.observer_artifact_requirement: The same harness run must contain the exact minute-10080 abstract watch arrival with no observation, a post-arrival source-OMT-to-watch sound observation, an explicit pre-return absence of returned_report, the physical return transition, and one bounded returned-lead audit for the source-owned sound report. The artifact rows are authoritative for this causal proof.
evidence_contract.failure_rule: No Phase-4 sound-positive credit unless exact dispatch and approach clocks, target-loaded/watch-abstract geometry, the no-observation minute-10080 arrival, the post-arrival sound observation, pre-return no-lead state, physical return, and one exact same-run returned_report sound lead are separately green.
